speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation and have a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes, and your labs are showing abnormalities. To understand the cause of these symptoms, how long have you noticed this yellowing and feeling agitated?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis A.

Thank you for the detailed history. Your age, recent travel/exposure risks, agitation, jaundice, and recent substance use strongly suggest an acute viral hepatitis. I need to confirm this with labs immediately; REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel (AST, ALT, Bilirubin, Alk Phos) and Viral Hepatitis Serologies (HAV, HBV, HCV).
